action.mutates: creates the master-side manifests directory /etc/puppetlabs/code/environments/production/manifests (absent on an agent node) and runs the checklist script once, which writes 97_integrity.pp there

outcomes.outcome: the checklist script carries the master's manifests directory, the output file and the file list, root 0755
run, the script writes 97_integrity.pp with $integrity_checklist holding the listed files' md5sum lines joined by ':'
the generated variable reaches the nodes' integrity check (compiled from the master's manifests into a node's catalog as sysmon_integrity_node's checklist)

uncovered.why: the link is made in a node definition on the master (checklist => $integrity_checklist), which no class declares; the lab node is an agent, and a phase3 set applies one class through the lab master with a params fixture
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a phase3 set compiled against a site manifest on a master-role node (the master's generated 97_integrity.pp in the agent's catalog)
uncovered.evidence: no baseline manifest passes $integrity_checklist (git grep integrity_checklist: only checklist-integrity.sh.erb); phase3.py applies through test_class.sh with a params fixture, and its host rules forbid running Puppet in any probe, actions included (FORBIDDEN[:3], 'runs Puppet'), so a set cannot compile the generated manifest itself
